newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: ANZ Grindlays launches Visa card in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Grindlays launches Visa card in Pakistan.

text.p: ANZ Grindlays Bank on Wednesday launched the ANZ Visa card in Pakistan, described as one of the fastest-growing credit card markets in Asia.
"The number of Visa card-holders alone in Pakistan grew by 220 percent in the last financial year (1995/96)," Azhar Hamid, the bank's general manager in Pakistan, told reporters.

"There is a growing acceptance of credit cards in Pakistan with more than 10,000 establishments participating locally. Over a million transactions of Visa cards were recorded last year, an increase of 289 percent over the previous year," Hamid said.
He said about 150,000 Visa, Master Card, American Express and Diners Club cards had been issued in Pakistan and the market was expected to grow 40 percent a year for the next five years.
